title: Resting Energy Requirement (RER)
text: Calculate daily calories = 70 × (Weight in kg)^0.75 multiplied by life stage factor to prevent obesity.

title: Hydration Balance
text: Dogs need ~60mL of water per kg daily; cats need ~50mL. Provide clean, filtered water at all times.

title: Dental Prophylaxis
text: 80% of pets over age 3 show signs of periodontal disease. Brush teeth 3x weekly with enzymatic toothpaste.
